_doc: INSTITUTION #0 (WITNESS STAGE) — THE REGISTER OF COMMITMENTS BEING WATCHED.
CONFIRMED BY EMIL, 18 September 2026 (evening). All four entries carry status
'confirmed_by_emil_2026-09-18'. They were drafted as proposals by Claude and each
was ruled on individually; a status is the one field a model may not set for
itself, and publish_table.py reads it as the first of its two gates.
THE SFA LINK STAYS UNVERIFIED under the same ruling. Confirming the commitment is
not confirming a guess about who an actor is: SFA appears exactly as RSF's counts
stop, and that is a coincidence of dates, not UCDP joining them. Its counts are
still kept separate and it still never reaches the public table.
THE RULE FOR ENTERING (C4). A commitment enters this file only if ALL FIVE hold:
(i)   it has a public, dated text;
(ii)  it was signed or declared BY THE ACTOR ITSELF. A demand made ON an actor does
not qualify — this is why UNSC 2735 is NOT here: the Security Council is not a
party, and watching a party against somebody else's resolution measures
compliance with a demand, not the keeping of a promise;
(iii) it concerns civilians or a ceasefire;
(iv)  it names actors that appear in UCDP GED `side_a`, verified against the actual
strings in the data and recorded below EXACTLY as UCDP spells them;
(v)   it has not been formally terminated.
WHY (iv) IS A LIST WITH DATES AND NOT A NAME — the finding that shaped this file.
Verifying (iv) against GEDEvent_v26_1 + the 2026 candidates on 18 Sep 2026 showed
that UCDP RE-CODES actors mid-series, and two of the three entries here are affected:
Sudan     'RSF'  has one-sided events in 2023, 2024, 2025 and NONE in 2026.
'SFA'  appears only from 2025 (187 events by Jul 2026).
DR Congo  'M23'  has one-sided events in 2023 ONLY (33).
'AFC'  runs 2023-2026 (231) — M23 joined the AFC coalition in Dec 2023.
A register that wrote 'RSF' and watched it fall to zero in 2026 would publish the
cleanest imaginable signal that the Jeddah Declaration is being honoured, and the
signal would be an artefact of a coding decision in Uppsala. So each entry lists every
string, with the window it covers, and the ledger records WHICH string produced each
count. Where the link between two strings is our inference and not UCDP's statement,
it is marked `link: unverified` and the counts are kept SEPARATE, never summed.
actor_unknown: UCDP codes an unidentified perpetrator as XXXnnn. Those events are
counted and reported on their own line and are NEVER charged to a party that signed
anything.
Source names are locked so that a swap back to ACLED is one config line: the field is
`actor_strings`, and the key inside it is the source id ('ucdp' today).
_verified_against: GEDEvent_v26_1.csv + GEDEvent_v26_01_26_06.csv + GEDEvent_v26_0_7.csv, merged by id, 18 Sep 2026

commitments.title: Jeddah Declaration of Commitment to Protect the Civilians of Sudan
commitments.commitment_text: The Parties commit to... ensure the protection of civilians at all times, to allow and facilitate the rapid and unimpeded passage of humanitarian relief, and to refrain from any attack that may cause civilian casualties or damage to civilian objects.

ucdp.note: UCDP has no 'SAF' string; the state party is 'Government of Sudan'. 53 one-sided events 2023-2026.
311 one-sided events 2023-2025 and NONE in 2026. The absence is what must not be read as compliance without the next line being settled.

187 one-sided events 2025-2026, dyad 'SFA - Civilians'. It appears exactly as RSF's counts stop. WHETHER THIS IS THE RSF UNDER A NEW CODING IS OUR GUESS AND NOT UCDP'S STATEMENT. Counted on its own line, never summed into RSF. Emil or UCDP settles it.

commitments.title: Washington Accord — Peace Agreement between the DRC and the Republic of Rwanda
commitments.commitment_text: The Parties shall cease hostilities and refrain from acts of aggression, and shall not provide support to non-state armed groups.

ucdp.note: 40 one-sided events 2023-2025, coded in DR Congo (Zaire).

commitments.title: Doha Declaration of Principles — Government of the DRC and the AFC/M23
commitments.commitment_text: The Parties commit to an immediate and permanent ceasefire, to refrain from attacks against civilians and from hate propaganda, and to the restoration of State authority.

ucdp.note: 231 one-sided events 2023-2026. The AFC is the coalition M23 joined in Dec 2023 and is the string UCDP uses now.
33 one-sided events in 2023 ONLY. Kept so that a reader of the history sees why the M23 line stops, and NOT because events are expected under it after the commitment date.

commitments.title: Gaza ceasefire and hostage-release agreement accepted by the parties
commitments.commitment_text: A complete ceasefire, the release of hostages and detainees, the withdrawal of forces from populated areas, and the entry of humanitarian assistance at scale.
commitments.not_unsc_2735_because: UNSC 2735 (2024-06-10) is a demand made ON the parties by a body that is not a party. Rule (ii) excludes it. This entry is the agreement the parties themselves accepted.

ucdp.note: 18 one-sided events, 2023 and 2026. UCDP codes Gaza events under country 'Israel'; there is no 'Palestine' country string in GED 26.1.
